title: Inspector closes when a system activation becomes pending (phone)
description: Nightly 2026-10-16 finding 4: on a phone the system inspector, opened to look at a system, stayed open when the decision switched to 'activate a system' and covered the map. It now closes on the new activation decision on phone layouts; desktop keeps it open beside the map. Before shots were taken with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before on the base commit; after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- ET, which asserts the inspector is gone on the phone. Mocked fixtures.

shots.caption: A system tapped to look at it; the inspector covers part of the map.
